description: Synthetic Simulation Data of Wind Power Time Series in Germany is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Viktor Walter. This dataset contains synthetic wind power generation time series for 160 locations in Germany. The data is provided at an hourly resolution covering a two-year period. It was generated using an open-source, reproducible simulation framework described in the publication "Synthetic Data Simulation Framework for Wind Power Time Series". Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
